label: prf:categorical-q-connection-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical $q$-connection
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of the categorical q-connection

\nabla exists by (existence of categorical connections). \iota_\xi \nabla \circ \varTheta is the composite of the connection with the Reeb interior product and the contact form — each a morphism in \mathbf{C}. The scalars q^{-1}, (1 - q^{-1}) give an R-linear combination, well-defined in any R-linear category.
